capabilities: Insert margin notes beside paragraphs via command or inline syntax
Tag notes with types that get color-coded in the margin
Enable margin notes per file, folder, or vault-wide via frontmatter or settings
Run an AI agent that suggests and places margin notes
Define custom agent profiles as markdown files
extras: The AI agent sends file text to the chosen provider; the README documents network use, key storage behavior (Obsidian secret storage on 1.11.4+, plaintext data.json fallback with a warning on older versions), and notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no way to write side comments next to a paragraph in the margin, the way one scribbles in the margin of a physical book.

requires.name: Anthropic, OpenAI, or Google API key

summary: Margin notes plugin that lets you jot inline margin comments next to any paragraph, enabled per file, folder, or vault, with an optional AI notes agent.
